resources.string: A dotted ring of today’s progress, with weekday and date. Refreshes about every 15 minutes.
One dot per battery percent, plus charging status. Refreshes about every 15 minutes.
Four dotted bars tracking your day, week, month and year. Choose your week start and fill style in Playbox. Refreshes about every 15 minutes.
Responsive Nothing-style battery meter with ring, dot or bar modes and charging time when Android can estimate it.
Your next system alarm, day and time-until, rendered in the Nothing visual language.
A 100-dot internal-storage meter. Choose whether it shows free or used space.
A compact monthly calendar with today highlighted and the same configurable week start as Time Bars.
A slim seven-day strip for the current week with today highlighted. Resizes from compact to wide.
Every day of the year in a 12-row dot matrix. Switch between elapsed and remaining days.
Battery, free storage, next alarm and today’s progress in one Nothing-style dashboard.
Countdown to the weekend, next month or next year with a dotted progress track.
A live home-screen clock using Nothing OS NDot57 on Nothing phones, with automatic system-time updates.
One-tap access to the Matrix studio, widget gallery and Nothing OS Always-on Glyph Toy selector.
A four-item checklist you can complete directly on the home screen. Each widget keeps its own list.
Local time beside a chosen world time zone, with both dates visible when midnight differs.
Live preview of four dotted time progress bars
Scattered dots build up in a stable pattern as each period passes.
Dots fill %1$s as each period passes.
Refreshes about every 15 minutes. Android battery saving may delay bitmap widgets.
System-driven widget: no periodic worker needed.
Interactive widget: task checks update immediately and need no periodic worker.
Bitmap widgets refresh together about every 15 minutes and immediately on relevant clock, alarm or charging events.
Long-press your home screen → Widgets → Nothing Playbox → %1$s.
Finish adding the widget in your launcher.
A vertical dotted battery gauge with percentage and charging status.
Seven days stacked vertically, with today highlighted. Uses your chosen week start.
